item.title: System of a Down and Faith No More Announce First Australian and New Zealand Tour in Over a Decade
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[INTRO MUSIC FADES OUT]
Host: "Get ready, Australia and New Zealand! System of a Down is returning to the region for the first time in over a decade, and they're bringing Faith No More along for the ride! The band has just announced a stadium tour, kicking off in January 2027."
[SHORT MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: "The tour was teased with some clever marketing stunts last week, with murals and light projections popping up in major cities. And now, we have the details. System of a Down will be playing Accor Stadium in Sydney on January 22, Marvel Stadium in Melbourne on January 27, Suncorp Stadium in Brisbane on February 1, and Hnry Stadium in Wellington on February 7."
[SHORT MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: "Tickets go on sale this Friday, July 31, with presales starting earlier in the week. It's been a long wait for fans, with System of a Down's last Australian dates back in 2012. And with Faith No More joining them, it's shaping up to be an epic show. Both bands have had an incredible impact on the music scene, with System of a Down's album 'Toxicity' and Faith No More's 'The Real Thing' still widely popular today."
[SHORT MUSIC TRANSITION]
Host: "System of a Down is known for their impressive chart success, including two number one albums in the same year, a feat they shared with Led Zeppelin. And with Faith No More's influential sound, which helped pioneer the rap-rock fusion of the 90s, this tour is not to be missed. Mark your calendars, and get ready to rock out with two of the most iconic bands in the business!"
[OUTRO MUSIC FADES IN]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
[OUTRO MUSIC CONTINUES TO PLAY AS THE EPISODE ENDS]
